name: Aethermaw Linnorm - Adult
description: Adult Aethermaw is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with armoured black plates and translucent cyan aether-sensing organs. It seeks to feed on concentrated aether in the deep. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Armoured Bite
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Aether Scent
abilities.description: The linnorm senses the direction of active concentrated aether within Far range, even through water or a ship’s hull.

abilities.name: Scalding Brine
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress from scalding brine and shell shards. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Hull-Crushing Coil
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against a vessel or one creature within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+5 physical damage; a creature is also Restrained until it escapes with a successful Strength Roll.

abilities.name: Spined Tail
abilities.description: When a creature within Very Close range damages the linnorm, mark a Stress to attack that creature with a +5 modifier for 2d10+5 physical damage.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
